messages.content:
Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Please post a narrowly scoped correction comment on the archived April 21, 2023 staff note at document ID `doc_staff_archive_2023_04_21`. Correct the status language based on what I said at that meeting and identify the evidence gate that was still outstanding then. Keep the comment explicitly tied to the April 21 meeting rather than later outcomes.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "post_doc_comment", "arguments": {"doc_id": "doc_staff_archive_2023_04_21", "body": "Correction tied to the April 21, 2023 staff meeting: I said the leading hypothesis held, but the churn problem was not yet established as fixed. Cohort 2 did not show the fix failing; its dip appeared consistent with a one-off CS-side outage, while signup-source and tier cuts remained clean. The outstanding evidence gate at that meeting was for cohort 3 to land and hold the result the following week before calling it fixed."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_141_02", "path": "args", "criterion": "The comment must be explicitly framed as a correction to the April 21, 2023 staff-meeting record and convey that, as of that meeting, the churn issue should not yet have been described as fixed: the leading hypothesis still appeared to hold, but cohort 3 still needed to land before Riley would call it fixed. Later outcomes must not be substituted for the status as of April 21. Missing or contradicting any of these points fails.", "value": {"doc_id": "doc_staff_archive_2023_04_21", "body": "Correction tied to the April 21, 2023 staff meeting: I said the leading hypothesis held, but the churn problem was not yet established as fixed. Cohort 2 did not show the fix failing; its dip appeared consistent with a one-off CS-side outage, while signup-source and tier cuts remained clean. The outstanding evidence gate at that meeting was for cohort 3 to land and hold the result the following week before calling it fixed."}}]}
